projects.title: Ad click count aggregation
projects.description:
Designed and implemented an ad click aggregation pipeline components using Kafka and gRPC, adopting a map-reduce
approach to count ad clicks at a minute level. Leveraged Kubernetes to scale and manage various components

● Developed a full stack web application, back-end REST API using NodeJS, Express, MongoDB, PassportJS, and front-end
with AngularJS (1.0). Integrated third-party Twilio messaging and Braintree payment APIs
● Transformed the application into a scalable system by leveraging AWS services such as ALB, ECS, SQS, and lambda
